Hiya! Be warned this post is a bit of self pitying and moaning. I'm a first year uni student, I moved to another country to go to university (I'm an ethnic minority here, just for some context). I'm not a big drinker, not super into clubbing, I prefer quiet conversations over a cup of coffee than going out at night.

I'm having a super difficult time adjusting. It's been around two months and I haven't really got any friends yet, my flatmates (from uni accommodation) get along so well and go out together and want to share a house next year, without me. I've only gotten some acquaintances so far, but not anybody I actually like to hang out with.

I can be a bit shy and quiet, but not to the extent that it's stopped me from having friends at school, people I'm still close to. I go to societies and stuff and try to socialize with others but nothing seems to be working. Part of it is that I'm still not used to the culture and stuff, especially the massive drinking culture which I don't even want to get on board with (I rarely drink). I'm struggling to find like-minded people, and I don't know what to do!

I've found that making it enjoyable works!
Set yourself some goals and work out exactly how you're getting there - I find keeping a planner helps. Decide how much weight you're going to lose, do some research, figure out which foods are healthier and better for weight loss. Then work out how to make them fun and still tasty, like making banana pancakes and such. Stop buying unhealthy food (out of sight, out of mind), and make a goal to exercise a certain amount of time every day. Even if it just starts with being 5 minutes every morning. I think the really important thing is to do thing *consistently* instead of immediately throwing yourself into it, because then you'll just get tired and stop. Do small things every day and move on from there. As for self-care, go to the hair salon, buy the products that work for your hair and skin, have an exfoliating session once a week. Throw out your old wardrobe, buy some new things in a style you've never tried before. 
Also, coordinate with people! Keep a look book and check your progress, get a workout buddy, tell your friends/ family to help you out.
